title: REQ · .gitignore uses a depth-independent node_modules/ rule
summary: The ignore file has an unanchored node_modules/ rule instead of game/node_modules/
description: The current rule `game/node_modules/` is anchored to game/ and misses game/frontend/node_modules. Replace it with `node_modules/` so any depth matches.
acceptance_criteria: Given .gitignore, when its lines are read, then a line equal to `node_modules/` exists
Given .gitignore, when its lines are read, then no line equals `game/node_modules/`
technical_constraints: Rule must contain no slash except the trailing one
